service: US Federal Contracts & SAM.gov Procurement B2G Radar
description: Extracts and audits official U.S. Federal Government contract awards via USAspending.gov v2 and SAM.gov APIs (Zero-Key required). Scores B2G vendor competitiveness (0-100), tracks DoD/HHS/VA awards, and generates Markdown procurement briefs.

inputSchema.title: US Federal Contracts & SAM.gov Procurement B2G Radar Input
inputSchema.description: Configure contract scope keyword, federal awarding agency filter, minimum award value in USD, and maximum results to extract and score U.S. Federal Government B2G contracts.

keyword.title: Contract Scope / Technology Keyword
keyword.description: Keyword searched in federal contract award descriptions (e.g., 'cybersecurity', 'cloud software', 'medical supplies', 'autonomous').

awardingAgency.title: Federal Awarding Agency (Optional)
awardingAgency.description: Optional filter by top-tier U.S. Federal Agency name (e.g., 'Department of Defense', 'Department of Veterans Affairs').

minAwardAmount.title: Minimum Contract Value (USD)
minAwardAmount.description: Minimum contract obligation amount in USD (0 to 1,000,000,000).

maxResults.title: Maximum Contracts to Extract
maxResults.description: Maximum number of federal contract awards to extract and score (1 to 100).

recipientName.title: Contractor / Recipient Name
recipientName.description: Legal entity awarded the federal contract.

awardingAgency.title: Awarding Agency
awardingAgency.description: Top-tier U.S. Federal Department or Agency.

awardAmountUsd.title: Award Amount (USD)
awardAmountUsd.description: Total federal contract award amount in USD.

startDate.title: Start Date
startDate.description: Contract period of performance start date (YYYY-MM-DD).

endDate.title: End Date
endDate.description: Contract period of performance end/renewal date (YYYY-MM-DD).

contractAwardType.title: Contract Award Type
contractAwardType.description: Federal procurement instrument type (Definitive Contract, Delivery Order, BPA Call, Purchase Order).

b2gOpportunityScore.title: B2G Opportunity Score (0-100)
b2gOpportunityScore.description: Quantitative score evaluating contract value, recompete window, and B2G subcontracting potential (0-100).

description.title: Contract Scope Description
description.description: Official summary of goods or services procured.

markdownProcurementBrief.title: Markdown B2G Procurement Intelligence Brief
markdownProcurementBrief.description: Executive Markdown dossier for GovCon capture teams, B2B sales, and AI RAG agents.

overview.title: US Federal Contracts & SAM.gov B2G Radar Overview
